cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, os, sys, time, selectors
# slow writer: total 200000 bytes, written in 64KB chunks with sleeps
p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'/tmp/nbtest.py'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
os.set_blocking(p.stdin.fileno(), False)
sel = selectors.DefaultSelector(); sel.register(p.stdin, selectors.EVENT_WRITE)
payload = b'x'*200000
sent = 0
while sent < len(payload):
    for k,_ in sel.select(0.5):
        n = os.write(p.stdin.fileno(), payload[sent:sent+65536]); sent += n
    time.sleep(0.05)
p.stdin.close()
print('sent', sent, 'child read', p.stderr.read().decode().strip())
EOF
